=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2323-2329 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: validation_owner_signature() keeps the literal `no-error-lines` sentinel from `error-signature` in the log-tail branch, so the `[ -z "${signature}" ]` guard is false and the fallback text is never used. The last run fixed the sentinel only in the fallback branch.
  WHY: Every sandbox-stage failure, and any stage whose log has no error-shaped line, gets the same fingerprint. One bounce marker then suppresses harness reports for unrelated failures. Reviewers rated this MAJOR; the severity is mapped to high.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2212-2222 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: validation_owner_enabled() treats any value other than ""/true as OFF. The poller (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2467-2473) treats invalid values as ON. gemini additionally says `1` is not recognised as truthy.
  WHY: With a malformed or `1` value, validate skips owner routing while the poller still holds for a harness fix. Severity disagreement: gemini MAJOR, the other three NIT; the highest (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2294-2296 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: validation_owner_load_bounced() creates an empty `validation_harness_bounced_fps.txt` before the login and comment reads. The early-return existence guard then memoizes an empty bounce set after a transient `gh api` failure.
  WHY: The bounce guard stays silently inactive for the rest of the run, so an already-bounced fingerprint is reported again as a fresh harness failure.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:validation_owner_signature() log-tail branch | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `no-error-lines` sentinel is fixed only in the fallback branch. The log-tail branch keeps it, so the fallback text is never used.
  WHY: Every sandbox-stage failure gets the same fingerprint (`sandbox:sandbox_unavailable:no-error-lines`). Bounce markers then match unrelated failures. The new test passes only because it runs with no log file.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:validation_owner_enabled() | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A value that is neither true nor false turns owner routing off, while the poller (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 2467-2473) treats it as ON.
  WHY: Needs a misconfigured variable. The outcome is inconsistent between validate and the poller.
- HARDENING: validation_owner_classify() discards the classifier's stderr (`2>/dev/null`). Suggested fix: redirect it to a runtime file and include its first line in the `fail_open` warning (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2212-2216 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: validation_owner_enabled() does not interpret all truthy values of VALIDATION_HARNESS_HEAL_ENABLED. It checks only 'true' or empty.
  WHY: Setting the variable to `1` silently disables owner routing, which is inconsistent with the shell truthiness checks used elsewhere.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2323-2328 (log-tail branch; the fallback-branch guard is at 2335-2339) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `no-error-lines` guard covers only the fallback branch. The log-tail branch at line 2326 assigns `signature` without sanitizing the sentinel, so the `[ -z "${signature}" ]` guard at line 2329 is false.
  WHY: `error_signature()` returns the literal "no-error-lines" (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2861), and the sandbox status file matches none of `_SIGNATURE_PATTERNS` (workflow_failure_heal.py:529-534). All sandbox failures then share one fingerprint. One bounce marker rewrites later sandbox failures to `bounced_repeat` (lines 1740-1742) and suppresses their reports. `validation_owner_ruled_out_block` collapses the same way.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2294-2296 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: validation_owner_load_bounced() creates the file empty before the reads. The failure paths `return 0` with it on disk, so the early-return existence guard memoizes an empty bounce set.
  WHY: A transient `gh api` failure disables the bounce guard for the rest of the run. Creating the file only after the jq parse succeeds fixes this.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2213-2222 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: validation_owner_enabled() resolves a non-boolean value to OFF. The poller (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2461-2472) resolves it to ON.
  WHY: With `maybe`, the poller holds for a fingerprint that validate never writes. Mirroring the poller's `*) -> true` shape would make both follow one contract.
- HARDENING 1: validation_owner_classify() discards classifier stderr, which hides real failures. Suggested fix: add `2>>"${out}.err"` and append the first line to the warning (about 2 lines).
- HARDENING 2: validation_owner_load_bounced() memoizes a failed read. Suggested fix: drop the pre-read truncation and write the file only in the final jq step (about 1 line).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2323-2329 (validation_owner_signature) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The log-based signature path keeps the literal `no-error-lines` result. The fallback summary is used only when `signature` is empty.
  WHY: For a nonempty log without recognized error lines, distinct failures with the same stage and reason get the same fingerprint. A bounce marker for one can suppress reporting another.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2212-2222 and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2467-2472 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: validate treats an invalid `VALIDATION_HARNESS_HEAL_ENABLED` as off, while the poller normalizes it to on.
  WHY: validate omits owner markers and fields while the poller still applies the harness hold. The poller uses its local fallback fingerprint.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 0
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
